acme_prod_engineer: Hey team — after the 2026-03-15 rollout our chat responses changed for prompts with trailing whitespace. Many of our prompts that used trailing spaces now return different completions and token counts. Example attached. Can someone look?

maria_support: sorry you're seeing this — can you paste a minimal request + response pair? which model + version are you calling?

acme_prod_engineer: model: redwood-3b-chat-2026-03-15 (the one that auto-upgraded this morning). Minimal repro: we send exactly the user message "Translate to French: Hello world   " (three spaces at end). Before rollout we got translation including a trailing space at end-of-output; after rollout the assistant snaps trimmed punctuation and changes phrasing. Also tokenization count changed from 11 tokens -> 9 tokens. Not sure what changed under the hood.

maria_support: thanks. Could you paste the actual curl you used (headers + body, obfuscate keys) and the response body you saw?

acme_prod_engineer: sure. request:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b-chat-2026-03-15","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Translate to French: Hello world   "}],"max_tokens":50}'
```response before (from snapshots):```json
{"id":"...","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Traduire en fran\u00E7ais : Bonjour le monde "}}]}
```response after rollout:```json
{"id":"...","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Traduire en fran\u00E7ais : Bonjour le monde"}}]}
```

maria_support: interesting — only difference is trailing space trimmed and token count drop. I'm going to escalate to ML/runtime. tagging @eva_ml and @rahul_engineering.

support-bot: :information_source: Incident created: #INC-2026-448-tokenizer-compat (severity: medium)

rahul_engineering: pinging in. was there an intentional tokenizer or chat-template change in the 2026-03-15 rollout? we had a batching optimization that altered whitespace normalization on streaming boundary.

eva_ml: quick summary from the model-onboarding notes: we merged PR that sets `trim_whitespace=true` by default in the chat template sanitizer to reduce empty-token overhead. It was intended to be a no-op for typical prompts but apparently some customers rely on trailing spaces for formatting.

acme_prod_engineer: wow — that default change would explain it. We rely on trailing-space signals in our template to indicate block boundaries. This breaks our in-production behavior. Is there a compat toggle?

rahul_engineering: not exposed in the public API yet. the runtime variant flip was to improve batching and token reuse. We can hotfix two ways: 1) rollback the sanitizer default for the deployed variant, or 2) add a per-request compatibility header that disables trimming for customers flagged for compatibility.

maria_support: what do you recommend as an immediate mitigation while you coordinate a fix?

eva_ml: short-term: you can add an invisible marker to the end of the message that survives the sanitizer, e.g. zero-width space (U+200B) or a sentinel token like `\uE000`. Example: "Translate to French: Hello world \u200B". That should preserve tokenization and spacing. Not ideal but quick.

acme_prod_engineer: adding U+200B fixed our repro locally, thanks. Could we get a docs/compatibility note and ideally an API header to opt out?

rahul_engineering: yes — plan: roll back sanitizer default on the current variant within 2 hours as an emergency mitigation (deploy-bot will show), and simultaneously add an opt-out header `X-Whitespace-Compat: legacy` in the next patch. We'll also add a runtime flag so Dedicated/Private customers can pin behavior.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Deploy started: rollback/sanitizer-default for redwood-3b-chat-2026-03-15 to variant v3.2.1 -> expected completion ~30m.

maria_support: keeping this thread open. acme, I'll follow up when rollback completes and after we add header support. any logs or sample token counts you can share help the postmortem.

acme_prod_engineer: will send token diffs and timestamps. thanks for fast response.

rahul_engineering: follow-up notes for internal ops: investigate why sanitizer flip was not gated behind compat flag. add unit test for trailing-space-preservation for chat templates. also add canary that runs customer prompt corpus to detect regressions pre-rollout.

eva_ml: logging action item: update model onboarding checklist and release notes to call out `trim_whitespace` behavioral impact.

support-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident #INC-2026-448 severity decreased to low after rollback.

maria_support: resolved for now — reopening if acme sees any remaining diffs. :thumbsup:
